text.en: Medial third of the superior nuchal line and external occipital protuberance; nuchal ligament; spinous processes of C7–T12 and their supraspinous ligaments.
text.zh: 上项线内侧三分之一、枕外隆凸；项韧带；第 7 颈椎至第 12 胸椎棘突及棘上韧带。

text.en: Posterior border of the lateral third of the clavicle; acromion; spine of the scapula.
text.zh: 锁骨外侧三分之一的后缘、肩峰和肩胛冈。

direction.en: Upper fibres descend outwards, middle fibres run across, and lower fibres ascend outwards towards the shoulder girdle.
direction.zh: 上部纤维向外下，中部横行，下部向外上，汇向肩带。

feel.en: Rest your fingers on the slope between neck and shoulder and shrug gently: the muscle there firms up. Squeeze your shoulder blades together and the area between them tightens too.
feel.zh: 手指放在脖子和肩膀之间的斜坡上，轻轻耸肩，那里的肌肉会变硬。再把两块肩胛骨往中间夹，它们之间也会绷紧。

mistakes.en: Treating every trapezius exercise as a shrug: the three parts pull the shoulder blade in different directions.
mistakes.zh: 以为练斜方肌就是耸肩：三个部分把肩胛骨拉向不同方向。

mistakes.en: Pinning the shoulder blades down while lifting the arms overhead, so they cannot turn upward.
mistakes.zh: 举手过头时硬把肩胛骨压住，让它没法向上旋转。

summary.en: Lifts, pulls back and turns the shoulder blade.
summary.zh: 上提、后缩并旋转肩胛骨。

detail.en:
A large, flat, diamond-shaped sheet over the upper back and the back of the neck. It is one muscle in three parts named by fibre direction: the descending (upper) part slopes down to the collarbone, the transverse (middle) part runs across to the acromion and scapular spine, and the ascending (lower) part climbs to the inner end of the spine [M47].

The parts can pull on their own or together. When the arm rises overhead, the upper and lower parts work with serratus anterior to turn the shoulder blade upward, so the socket faces up [M47] [M2]. That is why trapezius is more than a shrugging muscle.
detail.zh:
背上部和颈后一大片扁平的菱形肌肉。它是一块肌肉，按纤维方向分三部：降部（上斜方）向外下斜到锁骨，横部（中斜方）横着走到肩峰和肩胛冈，升部（下斜方）向外上斜到肩胛冈内侧端 [M47]。

三个部分可以各自用力，也可以一起用力。手臂举过头顶时，上部和下部与前锯肌配合，把肩胛骨向上旋转，让关节盂朝上 [M47] [M2]。所以斜方肌不只是“耸肩肌”。

text.en: Spinous processes of the lower thoracic vertebrae and their supraspinous ligaments, within the whole muscle attachment down to T12.
text.zh: 下位胸椎棘突及其棘上韧带，属于整块肌肉向下延伸至第 12 胸椎的起始区。

text.en: Aponeurosis to the tubercle at the apex of the smooth triangular area at the medial end of the scapular spine.
text.zh: 以腱膜止于肩胛冈内侧端光滑三角区尖端的结节。

direction.en: Up and out towards the root of the scapular spine.
direction.zh: 向外上斜行，走向肩胛冈根部。

feel.en: Lie face down and lift your arms into a Y, thumbs up: the area below and between the shoulder blades works. The middle trapezius and rhomboids work right next to it, so the feeling is shared.
feel.zh: 俯卧，双臂举成 Y 字、拇指朝上抬离地面：肩胛骨之间偏下的地方会用力。斜方肌横部和菱形肌就在旁边一起工作，所以这种感觉是几块肌肉共有的。

mistakes.en: Lifting the arms by arching the low back and flaring the ribs.
mistakes.zh: 靠腰背反弓、肋骨外翻把手臂抬高。

mistakes.en: Pressing the shoulders down so hard that the shoulder blade cannot turn upward.
mistakes.zh: 把肩膀使劲往下压，肩胛骨反而转不上去。

summary.en: Pulls the shoulder blade down; helps turn it up.
summary.zh: 把肩胛骨往下拉，并帮它向上旋转。

detail.en:
The lower fibres climb from the spines of the lower thoracic vertebrae, down to T12, and end in a flat tendon on a small tubercle at the inner end of the scapular spine [M47]. They pull the shoulder blade down and, because they tug on the inner end of the spine, help turn it upward as the arm rises.

Research shows: in 25 adults doing pull-ups and chin-ups, lower-trapezius EMG was higher in the overhand pull-up [M51]. Higher EMG is not by itself proof of more growth [M9].
detail.zh:
下部纤维从下位胸椎的棘突向上（最低到第 12 胸椎），以一片扁腱止于肩胛冈内侧端的一个小结节 [M47]。它把肩胛骨往下拉；因为拉的是肩胛冈的内端，抬臂时还能帮肩胛骨向上旋转。

研究显示：25 名成年人做正握引体向上和反握引体向上，下斜方的肌电在正握时更高 [M51]。肌电高本身不等于长得更多 [M9]。

text.en: Lower nuchal ligament and spinous processes of C7 and T1.
text.zh: 项韧带下部及第 7 颈椎、第 1 胸椎棘突。

text.en: Medial border of the scapula at the root of the scapular spine.
text.zh: 肩胛骨内侧缘，位于肩胛冈根部。

direction.en: Down and out from the spine to the medial scapular border.
direction.zh: 从脊柱向外下斜行，到肩胛骨内侧缘。

feel.en: It lies under trapezius, so you cannot feel it on its own. Squeeze your shoulder blades together: the firm band beside the spine, level with the top of the blades, includes it.
feel.zh: 它在斜方肌下面，单独摸不到。把两块肩胛骨往中间夹：脊柱旁、与肩胛骨上端同高的那条绷紧的肌肉里就有它。

mistakes.en: Pinching the shoulder blades by pushing the chest and ribs forward.
mistakes.zh: 靠挺胸、把肋骨往前顶来夹肩胛骨。

mistakes.en: Rowing with the shoulders shrugged up toward the ears.
mistakes.zh: 划船时耸着肩，肩膀往耳朵方向提。

summary.en: Draws the top of the shoulder blade toward the spine.
summary.zh: 把肩胛骨上部拉向脊柱。

detail.en:
A narrow strap from the lower end of the neck ligament and the spines of C7 and T1 to the inner border of the shoulder blade, level with the root of the scapular spine [M47] [M2]. It sits just above rhomboid major and works with it: both pull the blade toward the spine (retraction) and help turn its socket downward.

Rows train it together with rhomboid major and the middle trapezius. No exercise separates the two rhomboids.
detail.zh:
一条窄窄的肌肉，从项韧带下端和第 7 颈椎、第 1 胸椎的棘突，走到肩胛骨内侧缘、与肩胛冈根部同高的地方 [M47] [M2]。它紧挨在大菱形肌上方，和大菱形肌一起工作：把肩胛骨拉向脊柱（后缩），并让关节盂向下转。

划船时它和大菱形肌、斜方肌横部一起出力。没有哪个动作能把大、小菱形肌分开练。

text.en: Transverse processes of C1 and C2; posterior tubercles of the transverse processes of C3 and C4.
text.zh: 第 1、2 颈椎横突，以及第 3、4 颈椎横突后结节。

text.en: Medial border of the scapula between the superior angle and the root of the scapular spine.
text.zh: 肩胛骨内侧缘，在上角与肩胛冈根部之间。

direction.en: Down and out from the upper neck to the upper inner corner of the shoulder blade.
direction.zh: 从上颈部向外下斜行，到肩胛骨内上方。

feel.en: Its lower end lies under trapezius near the top inner corner of the shoulder blade. Shrug gently and the side of the neck firms up; do not press hard there.
feel.zh: 它的下端藏在斜方肌下面，靠近肩胛骨内上角。轻轻耸肩，颈侧会变紧；不要用力按压那里。

mistakes.en: Tilting or poking the head forward to make a shrug look higher.
mistakes.zh: 耸肩时歪头或往前探头，假装提得更高。

mistakes.en: Rolling the shoulders in circles: it adds nothing to the lift.
mistakes.zh: 耸肩时绕圈转肩：对上提没有帮助。

summary.en: Lifts the upper inner corner of the shoulder blade.

detail.en:
A strap from the transverse processes of the top four neck vertebrae (C1–C4) down to the inner border of the shoulder blade, between its top corner and the root of the spine [M47]. It lifts the shoulder blade and helps turn its socket downward; with the shoulder blade held still, it helps bend the neck to its own side [M47].

Shrugs load its lifting action together with the upper trapezius.
detail.zh:
一条带状肌肉，从上面四节颈椎（第 1–4 颈椎）的横突向下，止于肩胛骨内侧缘、在上角与肩胛冈根部之间 [M47]。它上提肩胛骨，并帮关节盂向下转；肩胛骨固定时，还能帮颈部向同侧屈 [M47]。

耸肩时它和斜方肌降部一起承担上提的工作。

text.en: Spinous processes of the lowest two thoracic and upper two or three lumbar vertebrae, with their supraspinous ligaments. The thin aponeurosis blends with thoracolumbar fascia.
text.zh: 最下方两个胸椎和上方两个或三个腰椎棘突及其棘上韧带；薄的起始腱膜与胸腰筋膜相融合。

text.en: Inferior borders of the lowest four ribs, just lateral to their angles.
text.zh: 最下方 4 根肋骨的下缘，在肋角稍外侧。

direction.en: Up and out from the lower spine into separate slips on the lower ribs.
direction.zh: 从下位脊柱向外上斜行，以分开的肌齿连到下位肋骨。

feel.en: It lies under latissimus dorsi over the lowest ribs and cannot be felt on its own.
feel.zh: 它在背阔肌下面，盖在最下面几根肋骨上，单独摸不到。

mistakes.en: Claiming that a row or deadlift isolates this small muscle.
mistakes.zh: 声称某个划船或硬拉动作能单独练到这块小肌肉。

mistakes.en: Taking pain over a lower rib as proof that this muscle is strained.
mistakes.zh: 把下位肋骨处的疼痛当成这块肌肉拉伤的证据。

summary.en: A thin sheet to the lower ribs; its role is debated.
summary.zh: 连到下位肋骨的薄肌片，作用仍有争议。

detail.en:
A thin sheet from the spines of the last two thoracic and first two or three lumbar vertebrae to the lower borders of the lowest four ribs, just beyond their angles [M47]. Gray describes it as drawing the lower ribs down and back.

Whether it really helps breathing is uncertain. Vilensky and colleagues questioned a breathing role and suggested it may help sense body position instead; that idea is not proven either [M50]. No exercise is known to train it on its own.
detail.zh:
一片薄肌，从最后两个胸椎和最上面两三个腰椎的棘突，走到最下面四根肋骨的下缘、肋角稍外侧 [M47]。格雷把它描述为把下位肋骨往后下方拉。

它是否真的参与呼吸并不确定。Vilensky 等人质疑它的呼吸作用，提出它可能参与感知身体的位置，但这个说法也没有得到证明 [M50]。目前没有已知能单独练它的动作。

text.en: A shared broad tendon from the posterior iliac crest, posterior sacrum, lower lumbar spinous processes and related ligaments; more cranial parts also arise from ribs and vertebrae.
text.zh: 共同的宽腱起于髂嵴后部、骶骨后面、下位腰椎棘突及相关韧带；更上方的部分还起于肋骨和椎骨。

text.en: Ribs and vertebral processes in successive levels; the complete group also extends to the neck and skull. This topic displays its lumbar and thoracic portions.
text.zh: 分段止于肋骨和椎骨突起；完整肌群还延伸至颈部和颅骨。本主题展示腰段与胸段。

direction.en: Long columns run upwards on each side of the spine: iliocostalis outside, longissimus in the middle, spinalis inside.
direction.zh: 在脊柱两侧向上纵行：外侧髂肋肌，中间最长肌，内侧棘肌。

feel.en: Put your fingertips beside the middle of your lower back and hinge forward a little at the hips: the two columns firm up as they hold the spine.
feel.zh: 指尖放在下背中线两旁，从髋部稍微向前俯身：两条肌柱会绷紧，把脊柱稳住。

mistakes.en: Lifting a deadlift by rounding the back and then straightening it.
mistakes.zh: 硬拉时先弓背、再靠挺背把杠拉起来。

mistakes.en: Leaning back past upright at the top of a deadlift or back extension.
mistakes.zh: 硬拉或背伸展到顶后继续往后仰。

summary.en: Straightens the spine and holds it steady.

detail.en:
Not one muscle but three long columns on each side of the spine: iliocostalis on the outside, longissimus in the middle and spinalis next to the spinous processes. They share a broad tendon from the back of the iliac crest, the sacrum and the lower lumbar spines, and climb in overlapping slips to the ribs, the vertebrae, the neck and the skull [M47] [M49].

They can bend the spine backward, and one side helps bend it sideways. In lifting they mostly do something else: in a deadlift the hips and knees straighten while the erectors work isometrically, staying the same length to hold the back in a neutral position [M55].
detail.zh:
竖脊肌不是一块肌肉，而是脊柱两侧各三条长肌柱：外侧是髂肋肌，中间是最长肌，紧贴棘突的是棘肌。它们共用一条宽腱，起于髂嵴后部、骶骨和下位腰椎的棘突，再一段压一段地向上，止于肋骨、椎骨，一直到颈部和颅骨 [M47] [M49]。

它们能让脊柱向后伸，单侧收缩还帮躯干侧屈。可在举起重物时，它们主要做的是另一件事：硬拉时伸直的是髋和膝，竖脊肌做等长收缩，长度不变，把背稳在中立位 [M55]。

text.en: Common erector-spinae tendon at the posterior iliac crest and sacrum, with lower lumbar attachments.
text.zh: 髂嵴后部与骶骨处的竖脊肌共同腱，以及下位腰椎附着。

text.en: Inferior borders of the angles of the lowest six or seven ribs in Gray’s description.
text.zh: 格雷的描述为最下方 6 或 7 根肋骨肋角的下缘。

direction.en: Up and slightly out from the pelvis to the lower ribs, on the lateral edge of the erector group.
direction.zh: 从骨盆向上、稍向外走行，到下位肋骨，位于竖脊肌群外侧。

feel.en: The outer edge of the column beside your lower spine firms up when you hinge forward a little; by touch it cannot be told apart from longissimus.
feel.zh: 稍微向前俯身时，下背脊柱旁肌柱的外缘会绷紧；但用手摸分不清它和最长肌。

mistakes.en: Rounding the back under load to “feel the lower back more”.
mistakes.zh: 负重时故意弓背，想让下背“更有感觉”。

mistakes.en: Taking a stronger low-back burn as a sign of better technique.
mistakes.zh: 把下背更酸当成动作更标准的证据。

summary.en: Outer column: from the pelvis to the lower ribs.
summary.zh: 外侧肌柱，从骨盆到下位肋骨。

detail.en:
The lumbar part of the outer column. It rises from the common erector tendon on the iliac crest and sacrum and inserts by six or seven flat tendons on the lower borders of the angles of the lowest six or seven ribs [M47].

Lying furthest from the midline, it helps bend the trunk to its own side as well as backward [M47] [M49]. In the exercises listed it mostly holds the low back still.
detail.zh:
外侧肌柱的腰段。它从髂嵴和骶骨上的竖脊肌共同腱向上，以六七条扁腱止于最下面六或七根肋骨的肋角下缘 [M47]。

它离中线最远，除了伸脊柱，还帮躯干向同侧侧屈 [M47] [M49]。在所列的动作里，它主要负责把下背稳住。

text.en: Upper borders of the angles of the lowest six ribs, medial to the lumbar part’s insertions.
text.zh: 最下方 6 根肋骨肋角的上缘，在腰部止点内侧。

text.en: Angles of the upper six ribs and the posterior aspect of the transverse process of C7.
text.zh: 上方 6 根肋骨的肋角及第 7 颈椎横突后面。

direction.en: Upwards from the lower rib angles to the upper ribs and lower neck.
direction.zh: 从下位肋角向上，走向上位肋骨和颈部下端。

feel.en: It lies on the back of the ribs under the shoulder-blade muscles and cannot be felt on its own.
feel.zh: 它贴在肋骨背面、肩胛周围肌肉的下面，单独摸不到。

mistakes.en: Letting the upper back round as the weight pulls the arms down in a row.
mistakes.zh: 俯身划船时让重量把上背拉弯。

mistakes.en: Over-arching the upper back at the top of a row to look “proud”.
mistakes.zh: 划船到顶时过度挺胸、弓起上背。

summary.en: Outer column, continued up the back of the ribs.
summary.zh: 外侧肌柱在胸廓背面向上延续。

detail.en:
The middle stretch of the outer column. It starts on the upper borders of the angles of the lowest six ribs, just inside where the lumbar part ends, and reaches the angles of the upper six ribs and the back of the transverse process of C7 [M47]. Overlapping like runners in a relay, the segments make one long column from the pelvis to the neck.

It helps keep the upper back straight, for example while you hold a bent-over row position.
detail.zh:
外侧肌柱的中段。它起于最下面六根肋骨的肋角上缘，就在腰髂肋肌止点的内侧，向上止于上面六根肋骨的肋角和第 7 颈椎横突的后面 [M47]。像接力一样一段接一段，一条长肌柱才能从骨盆一直延续到颈部。

它帮上背保持挺直，例如俯身划船时稳住躯干。

text.en: The common erector-spinae tendon on the back of the iliac crest, the sacrum and the lumbar spinous processes.
text.zh: 竖脊肌共同腱：髂嵴后部、骶骨和腰椎棘突。

text.en: Transverse and accessory processes of the lumbar vertebrae; tips of the transverse processes of all thoracic vertebrae; the lower nine or ten ribs between their tubercles and angles.
text.zh: 腰椎横突和副突；全部胸椎横突的尖端；下面九或十根肋骨的肋结节与肋角之间。

direction.en: Long ascending bundles in the middle erector column, with slips to vertebrae and ribs.
direction.zh: 在中间肌柱中以长肌束向上走行，分出肌束连到椎骨和肋骨。

feel.en: The thick columns either side of your lower spine are mostly longissimus. Hinge forward a little and they firm up under your fingers.
feel.zh: 下背脊柱两侧那两条粗粗的肌柱，大部分是最长肌。稍微向前俯身，手指下面就会绷紧。

mistakes.en: Rounding the back under load to “feel the lower back more”.
mistakes.zh: 负重时故意弓背，想让下背“更有感觉”。

mistakes.en: Taking a stronger low-back burn as a sign of better technique.
mistakes.zh: 把下背更酸当成动作更标准的证据。

summary.en: Middle column: the largest part of the erectors.
summary.zh: 中间肌柱，竖脊肌里最大的一条。

detail.en:
The largest of the erector columns. It rises from the common tendon and inserts all the way up: on the lumbar transverse and accessory processes, by rounded tendons on the tips of the transverse processes of every thoracic vertebra, and by fleshy slips on the lower nine or ten ribs between their tubercles and angles [M47].

It is the main extensor of the spine in this region and, on one side, helps bend the trunk sideways [M49]. In a deadlift it mostly works isometrically to keep the back from rounding [M55].
detail.zh:
竖脊肌中最大的一条。它起于共同腱，一路向上附着：腰椎的横突和副突，以圆形的腱止于每一节胸椎横突的尖端，再以肉质肌齿止于下面九或十根肋骨的肋结节与肋角之间 [M47]。

它是这一段脊柱主要的伸肌，单侧收缩还帮躯干侧屈 [M49]。硬拉时它主要做等长收缩，不让背弓起来 [M55]。

text.en: Spinous processes of T11, T12 and the upper two lumbar vertebrae in Gray’s description.
text.zh: 格氏解剖学描述为起于第 11、12 胸椎及上方 2 个腰椎的棘突。

text.en: Spinous processes of upper thoracic vertebrae, with variable number and extent.
text.zh: 上位胸椎棘突，附着的数目与范围有变异。

direction.en: Nearly vertical beside the spinous processes, medial to longissimus.
direction.zh: 在棘突旁近乎竖直向上，位于最长肌内侧。

feel.en: It lies right beside the bony bumps down the middle of the back, under other muscles; you cannot feel it on its own.
feel.zh: 它紧贴背中线那排骨性突起，被其他肌肉盖住，单独摸不到。

mistakes.en: Rounding the back under load to “feel the lower back more”.
mistakes.zh: 负重时故意弓背，想让下背“更有感觉”。

mistakes.en: Taking a stronger low-back burn as a sign of better technique.
mistakes.zh: 把下背更酸当成动作更标准的证据。

summary.en: Inner column linking the spinous processes.
summary.zh: 内侧肌柱，连接各节棘突。

detail.en:
The smallest and innermost column. It arises by three or four tendons from the spinous processes of T11, T12, L1 and L2 and inserts on the spinous processes of the upper thoracic vertebrae, anywhere from four to eight of them [M47]. It is often blended with longissimus.

Its fibres run almost straight up beside the midline, so its job is to extend the spine rather than bend it sideways [M47] [M49].
detail.zh:
最小、最靠内的一条肌柱。它以三四条腱起于第 11、12 胸椎和第 1、2 腰椎的棘突，止于上位胸椎的棘突，数目从四个到八个不等 [M47]。它常与最长肌融合在一起。

它的纤维几乎贴着中线竖直向上，所以作用是伸脊柱，而不是侧屈 [M47] [M49]。

text.en: Outer surfaces and inferior borders of ribs 5–12.
text.zh: 第 5–12 肋的外面和下缘。

text.en: Anterior half of the iliac crest; an aponeurosis to the linea alba, pubic tubercle and pubic crest.
text.zh: 髂嵴前半；经腱膜连至腹白线、耻骨结节和耻骨嵴。

direction.en: Mostly down and in, like fingers slipping into front pockets; the posterior fibres run more vertically.
direction.zh: 主要向内下斜行，像手指插进前裤兜；后部纤维更接近竖直。

feel.en: Rest a palm on the side of your belly below the ribs and breathe out firmly, as if blowing out candles: the side wall tightens. Several abdominal layers firm together, so touch cannot single out this outer one.
feel.zh: 手掌放在肋骨下方的侧腹，像吹蜡烛那样用力呼气：侧腹壁会绷紧。几层腹肌会一起变紧，所以用手摸分不出最外面这一层。

mistakes.en: Twisting the trunk to help finish a one-arm row or carry.
mistakes.zh: 单臂划船或单侧负重行走时扭转躯干借力。

mistakes.en: Letting the ribs flare and the low back arch during a pull-up.
mistakes.zh: 引体向上时肋骨外翻、腰往后弓。

summary.en: Bends and turns the trunk; resists unwanted twisting.
summary.zh: 弯曲、转动躯干，也抵抗多余的扭转。

detail.en:
The outermost of the three flat side-wall muscles. Eight fleshy slips from the outer surfaces of the lower eight ribs run down and forward, then turn into a broad tendon sheet (aponeurosis) that reaches the front half of the iliac crest, the pubis and the linea alba down the middle of the belly [M47].

Both sides together bend the trunk forward; one side turns the trunk toward the opposite side and helps bend it sideways [M47]. In carries, planks and one-arm rows it mostly stops the trunk from twisting or arching.
detail.zh:
侧腹壁三层扁肌里最外面的一层。它以八个肉质肌齿起于下面八根肋骨的外面，纤维向前下方走，再变成一片宽阔的腱膜，止于髂嵴前半、耻骨和腹部正中的白线 [M47]。

两侧一起收缩让躯干前屈；单侧收缩让躯干转向对侧，并帮着侧屈 [M47]。负重行走、平板支撑和单臂划船时，它主要负责不让躯干扭转或向后弓。
